instruction: Create a scatter chart plotting Sales against COGS for all weeks in a new sheet. Title it "Sales vs COGS".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a scatter chart plotting Sales (column B) against COGS (column C) for all weeks in a new sheet (Sheet2). The evaluator checks: (1) Chart is in a new sheet named 'Sheet2' (0.2), (2) Chart type is ScatterChart (0.2), (3) Chart title is 'Sales vs COGS' (0.2), (4) Chart plots correct columns: X-axis=COGS (column C), Y-axis=Sales (column B) (0.2), (5) Chart includes all 10 weeks of data (0.2). Data verified from WeeklySales.xlsx containing 10 weeks of paired Sales and COGS data.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.2 for correct sheet name (Sheet2), 0.2 for correct chart type (ScatterChart), 0.2 for correct chart title, 0.2 for correct columns (X=COGS/column C, Y=Sales/column B), 0.2 for data completeness (all 10 weeks)
